headline: Türkiye's September exports hit a record: approaching 26 billion dollars
summary: Türkiye's September exports rose 15.4% year on year to 25.98 billion dollars, the highest September figure on record, with 12-month exports reaching a new peak of 283.7 billion dollars.
why: Export performance affects Türkiye's current account, foreign currency inflows and the lira, which are closely watched by investors in Turkish assets.
